author: (C. B. Adams, 1850)

note.en: A small pisa snail of Caribbean shallows. Here it is known only from one 1945 museum specimen from Limón, so it is a record.
note.es: Un caracol pisánido pequeño de aguas someras del Caribe. Aquí solo se conoce por un ejemplar de museo de 1945 de Limón, así que es solo un registro.

sources.t: GBIF occurrence records, Gandoca to Limón (INBio ATTA survey 1998 to 2003 and museum specimens)

recWhy: Only elsewhere on the coast or Bocas del Toro: GBIF: 1 museum record (Limón, 1945).
